description: This file defines a Java interface PermissionDao, which specifies data access methods for Permission entities in the sales management system. It extends a generic DAO interface and declares methods for listing permissions, fetching by ID, and filtering by groups and criteria.

classes.name: PermissionDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object interface for managing Permission entities within the sales management system.

methods.name: listPermission
methods.description: Returns a list of all Permission entities.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a Permission entity by its unique identifier.

methods.name: getPermissionsListByGroups
methods.description: Fetches a list of Permissions filtered by a set of permission IDs.

methods.name: listByCriteria
methods.description: Lists Permissions based on specified filtering criteria encapsulated in PermissionCriteria.
